name: parallel_sshi_fbr_zener
rationale: The reference FBR failed due to insufficient output voltage under heavy loads (S4-S6) and excessive voltage under light loads (S3). I am implementing a Parallel Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit. By adding an LC-tank (L1 and S1) in parallel with the piezo, we can invert the voltage on the piezo capacitance Cp at its extrema, significantly increasing the energy extracted per cycle. A full-bridge rectifier (FBR) is used to channel this energy to the storage capacitor, and a Zener diode (DZ33) is added to the output to clamp the voltage at 3.3V, ensuring v_max <= 3.6V for S3. A larger storage capacitor (4.7uF) is used to minimize ripple.
